name: Battle
overview: Scripture reveals that battle is fundamentally the Lord's work, as seen in Gideon's army crying out, 'The sword of the LORD' (Judges 7:20), emphasizing reliance on God's power rather than human might. The psalms affirm that God strengthens and equips His people for war, teaching their hands and fingers to fight (Psalms 18:39; 144:1), underscoring divine enablement in conflict. Calls to prepare for battle involve sanctification and spiritual readiness, as Joel exhorts warriors to prepare and John reminds believers that sanctification comes through God's truth (Joel 3:9; John 17:17). Finally, God's just vengeance executed with great rebuke (Ezekiel 25:17) affirms His sovereign role in the ultimate outcome of battles.
